description: This file defines Flask route handlers for managing service orders, including listing, creating, retrieving, and updating orders with role-based access control.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Handles retrieving and updating individual orders.

methods.name: _claims_or_401
methods.description: Extracts and decodes JWT token from request headers, aborts with 401 if invalid or missing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Lists orders for the current user or all orders if admin.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates a new order for the current user.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order if owner or admin.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Updates order status and notes, admin only.
